scope: Correct two-sided legality for groups whose complete occupied faces are disjoint. This does not qualify assembly height/thermal requirements or prove a smaller carrier.
defect: The composer disabled primary fanout reach for opposite faces, but still imposed nominal rectangle separation and rejected every final XY overlap. Thus even two pure opposite-face groups could not share XY space.

correction.evidence: FloorplanPrimaryFanout now carries an optional complete occupied-face union, derived from the same selected primary and child reservations used by occupancy. Zero means unknown, not empty.
rules: Remove only nominal body separations when both complete masks are known and disjoint.
Final rectangle overlap check uses the same complete face evidence.
Retain wider channel-demand separation, all hard electrical terms, wall constraints, exact separation checks and final physical occupancy validation.
Mixed-face and THT reservations contribute both occupied faces; logical exclusions remain conservative.
Reject invalid masks and any complete mask that omits its primary face.
Primitive callers without complete metadata retain their previous conservative behavior.
correction.implementation_cost: Reuse existing map references during separation construction. Prepare face-mask arrays once for the final quadratic overlap check, with no per-pair map lookup.

floorplan.name: native_floorplan_contracts
floorplan.coverage: Both movable/movable and movable/fixed pairs; all four approach directions; both faces; compact and legalize-only modes; independent exhaustive occupancy accepts opposite-face overlap and rejects THT collisions; mixed/unknown/invalid masks; wider channel constraints; both-board floorplan regressions.

final_code_screens.scope: Construction-only, prepared inputs, two runs per board. No new full source audit, DRC or renders in these screens; hashes match previously qualified rendered boards. Observer overhead included. These are not compile/full-build or matched Python comparison times.

final_code_screens.performance_claim: None. Current model times are higher than earlier non-interleaved screens; input extraction and unchanged downstream stages also slowed. No controlled A/B attribution or speedup is claimed.

remaining: Current qualified board sizes and layouts remain unchanged. Mixed-face groups still use conservative whole-zone rectangle separation; complete masks alone cannot model sparse secondary-face geometry. Need face-specific reservation geometry and coupled placement/legalization improvements, with independent collision checks. Other goal outcomes remain incomplete; no fabrication-readiness claim.
